<div class="pron-rule-row">
<p>
<strong>
Long / short.
</strong>
Long forms stand alone, after prepositions, or for contrast. Short forms sit in the clitic chain.
</p>
<p>
<strong>
<i lang="sr">
свој
</i>
</strong>
Use for own: my own, your own, his own, their own.
</p>
</div>

<div class="pron-rule-row">
<p>
<strong>
<i lang="sr">
Ово је...
</i>
</strong>
neuter singular for “this is / that is”.
</p>
<p>
<strong>
<i lang="sr">
Овај пас
</i>
</strong>
match the noun by gender, number, and case.
</p>
</div>
